ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels localized in the central and inner-medial regions, bordered by 25% low-intensity black pixels along the periphery and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region consists of contiguous white intensity. Symmetrically distributed clusters of low-intensity circular blobs are present in the upper-medial quadrants of both lobes. Black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edge and tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 48 degrees and a deep bounding-box recession relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes varying between 5 and 15 pixels; continuous jagged boundary from the median notch to both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge, transitioning to a sharp upward-tapering concavity at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, low-intensity (black) pixel regions distributed across the white ventral surface, predominantly in the upper half of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct diagonal linear disruptions on the right lobe (approximate 45-degree angle) and one vertical linear mark on the far left lobe intersecting the pigmentation border.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Live barnacle clusters attached to the extreme distal tips of both lobes; visible brown macroalgae (kelp) entanglement draped across the left lobe and central notch area.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multi-strand kelp stalks creating a visual occlusion across the left lobe pigmentation mapping.
